name: VKT7 Client
info:
Reads every current value of a Teplokom VKT-7 heat calculator over TCP (e.g. a Wiznet modem on its serial port), via the shared Vkt7Client class registered on functionGlobalContext in settings.js: service info, the units the device reports, current values and current totals of heat inputs input1/input2 and the device-wide elements, raw, named after the protocol's element table (t1, t2, P1, G1, V1, M1, Qo, VNR, VOS, NS...). Choosing the supply/return elements is left to the flow's collect-device-state. Send any message in to trigger a read; the same message comes out with `msg.payload` set to the result (null for elements outside the measurement scheme or with bad quality, deviceTime/timestamp as epoch ms). On failure nothing goes out and node.error() is called. ADDRESS is the calculator's network number (the built-in RS-485 adapter does not answer 0); WAKE_UP_BYTES is the count of 0xFF bytes before each request (2 for RS-232, 0 is fine for RS-485).

Through a GPRS modem that connects to us instead of waiting for a connection (БАРС-02 or ETA GSM; the gateway tells them apart by their hello): set GPRS_MODEM_ID to the identifier the modem sends on connect (БАРС-02: its CBN, e.g. Строителей_53; ETA GSM: its number, e.g. 0458); HOST and PORT are then unused. GPRS_LINE is the meter's line as the old dispatch system lists it: rs232 | rs232-powered | rs485, baud rate, 8N1 / 8E1 / 8O1 / 8N2 (default rs232 9600 8N1), or none to leave the modem's line as configured (old-firmware БАРС-02 3.0.1). The modems connect to one listener (global gprsModems, flow-space-nodered-a/src/device-readers/gprs-modems.js, port 2910; started at deploy), which reads one meter per modem at a time; over GPRS the read allows 15 s per request and at least 240 s in all. An ETA GSM keeps its wired RS-232/RS-485 port and gets the speed and format in band. See .docs/bars02/bars02-notes.md and .docs/eta-gsm/eta-gsm-notes.md.

name: KM5 Client
info:
Reads every current value of a TBN KM-5 heat meter over TCP (e.g. a Maestro modem on its RS-485 port), via the shared Km5Client class registered on functionGlobalContext in settings.js: firmware and type, status bytes, current values (commands 123 and 94) and totals with the clock (command 95), raw in the device's units and named after the protocol (GM1, GV1, t1, P1, W, M1, V1, Q, Tr...). Choosing the supply/return values is left to the flow's collect-device-state. Send any message in to trigger a read; the same message comes out with `msg.payload` set to the result (deviceTime/timestamp as epoch ms). On failure nothing goes out and node.error() is called. ADDRESS is the meter's network number, which is its factory number (e.g. 418200).

Through a GPRS modem that connects to us instead of waiting for a connection (БАРС-02 or ETA GSM; the gateway tells them apart by their hello): set GPRS_MODEM_ID to the identifier the modem sends on connect (БАРС-02: its CBN, e.g. Строителей_53; ETA GSM: its number, e.g. 0458); HOST and PORT are then unused. GPRS_LINE is the meter's line as the old dispatch system lists it: rs232 | rs232-powered | rs485, baud rate, 8N1 / 8E1 / 8O1 / 8N2 (default rs485 9600 8N1), or none to leave the modem's line as configured (old-firmware БАРС-02 3.0.1). The modems connect to one listener (global gprsModems, flow-space-nodered-a/src/device-readers/gprs-modems.js, port 2910; started at deploy), which reads one meter per modem at a time; over GPRS the read allows 15 s per request and at least 240 s in all. The РМ-5 speaks the same protocol (ADDRESS = its factory number, RS-485 9600 8N1). Through a modem, replies that lost their first 4 bytes (the network number) are accepted when they are valid with it put back. An ETA GSM keeps its wired RS-232/RS-485 port and gets the speed and format in band. See .docs/bars02/bars02-notes.md and .docs/eta-gsm/eta-gsm-notes.md.

name: TV7 Client
info:
Reads every current value of a Termotronic TV7 heat calculator over TCP (e.g. a Wiznet modem on its RS-232/RS-485 port), via the shared Tv7Client class registered on functionGlobalContext in settings.js: device info, instant values and totals for heat inputs input1/input2 and their pipes pipe1-pipe3, raw in SI units (GJ, MPa, m3, t) and named after the protocol tables (t, P, Go, Gm, F, V, M, Ftv, Qtv, VNR, VOS, NS...). Choosing the supply/return pipe and converting units is left to the flow's collect-device-state. Send any message in to trigger a read; the same message comes out with `msg.payload` set to the result (deviceTime/timestamp as epoch ms). On failure nothing goes out and node.error() is called. ADDRESS is the Modbus network address (1 by default); SERIAL_NUMBER, when set, is checked against the device's factory number.

Through a GPRS modem that connects to us instead of waiting for a connection (БАРС-02 or ETA GSM; the gateway tells them apart by their hello): set GPRS_MODEM_ID to the identifier the modem sends on connect (БАРС-02: its CBN, e.g. Строителей_53; ETA GSM: its number, e.g. 0458); HOST and PORT are then unused. GPRS_LINE is the meter's line as the old dispatch system lists it: rs232 | rs232-powered | rs485, baud rate, 8N1 / 8E1 / 8O1 / 8N2 (default rs232 9600 8N1), or none to leave the modem's line as configured (old-firmware БАРС-02 3.0.1). The modems connect to one listener (global gprsModems, flow-space-nodered-a/src/device-readers/gprs-modems.js, port 2910; started at deploy), which reads one meter per modem at a time; over GPRS the read allows 15 s per request and at least 240 s in all. Set SERIAL_NUMBER to the meter's factory number or empty (the default belongs to the example meter 19072584). Firmware 1.00 (the ТВ7 behind the БАРС-02 units, 2026-10-26) refuses the totals in one request; the client reads them in parts and leaves the device-wide block 3513-3532 (operating times, events, Qсум) null. An ETA GSM keeps its wired RS-232/RS-485 port and gets the speed and format in band. See .docs/bars02/bars02-notes.md and .docs/eta-gsm/eta-gsm-notes.md.

name: SPT943 Client
info:
Reads every current value of a НПФ «Логика» СПТ943 heat calculator (channel ОБЩ and heat inputs ТВ1, ТВ2) over TCP (a gateway on its RS-232 port, or a GPRS modem), via the shared Spt943Client class registered on functionGlobalContext in settings.js (flow-space-nodered-a/src/device-readers/spt943-client.js; the framing is in logika-protocol.js). Both protocol generations, told apart by the session reply: the original СПТ943 (RAM and FLASH dumps) and the СПТ943.1 with firmware 2.0.0.3.00 and later (М4). The result has the same shape for both: model, protocol (old | M4), VX, version, serialNumber, ID (ИД), EI (ЕИ, the units: 0 = Gcal, kgf/cm2; 1 = GJ, MPa; 2 = MWh, bar), deviceTime, DST (old: status register), protectionKey, DI, DO1, externalPower (М4: 0/1), common { tx, tv, NS, DS, Q }, TV1 and TV2 { SP, G1, G2, G3, P1, P2, t1, t2, dt, t3, tx, tv, NS, DS, V1, V2, V3, M1, M2, M3, Q, Qg, Ti, Tmin, Tmax, Tdt, Tep, Tf, Tn, Tsh } and inputs { X5-X20 } (input tests: Hz, mA, Ω), raw in the device's units and named after Логика's documents (НС → NS, ДС → DS: lists of the active numbers; Ти → Ti in hours); what a generation does not offer is null. An input without a sensor gives the device's own value for it (t about -242 °C, P negative). Choosing the supply/return pipe and converting units is left to the flow's collect-device-state. Send any message in to trigger a read (old protocol: 15 requests, about 70 s through a БАРС-02); the same message comes out with `msg.payload` set to the result (deviceTime/timestamp as epoch ms). On failure nothing goes out and node.error() is called. ADDRESS is the network number NT (0-99, 1 by default); SERIAL_NUMBER, when set, is checked against the serial number (old protocol: ИД, which is set to it).

Through a GPRS modem that connects to us instead of waiting for a connection (БАРС-02 or ETA GSM; the gateway tells them apart by their hello): set GPRS_MODEM_ID to the identifier the modem sends on connect (БАРС-02: its CBN, e.g. Зарипова_21; ETA GSM: its number, e.g. 0458); HOST and PORT are then unused. GPRS_LINE is the meter's line as the old dispatch system lists it: rs232 | rs232-powered | rs485, baud rate, 8N1 / 8E1 / 8O1 / 8N2 (default rs232-powered 9600 8N1; the meter's own speed is set by its КИ parameter: 0 or 10 = 2400, 1 or 11 = 9600, 2 or 12 = 19200), or none to leave the modem's line as configured (old-firmware БАРС-02 3.0.1). The modems connect to one listener (global gprsModems, flow-space-nodered-a/src/device-readers/gprs-modems.js, port 2910; started at deploy), which reads one meter per modem at a time (several СПТ on one RS-232 line, with different NT, are read one after another); over GPRS the read allows 15 s per request and at least 240 s in all. An ETA GSM keeps its wired RS-232/RS-485 port and gets the speed and format in band. See .docs/bars02/bars02-notes.md and .docs/eta-gsm/eta-gsm-notes.md.

name: SPT941 Client
info:
Reads every current value of a НПФ «Логика» СПТ941 heat calculator, models 941.10, 941.11 and 941.20, over TCP (a gateway on its RS-232 port, or a GPRS modem), via the shared Spt941Client class registered on functionGlobalContext in settings.js (flow-space-nodered-a/src/device-readers/spt941-client.js; the framing is in logika-protocol.js). The 941.10/11 speaks the old protocol (RAM and FLASH dumps), the 941.20 М4; the session reply tells them apart. The original СПТ941 (device code 54 29) is not read: the read fails with a message saying so. The result has the same shape for both: model (941.10/11 | 941.20), protocol (old | M4), VX, version, serialNumber, ID (ИД), EI (941.10/11: ЕИ, the units), EIP, EIQ (941.20: ЕИ/P, ЕИ/Q), deviceTime, DST (941.10/11: status register), protectionKey, DI1, DI2, DO1, externalPower (941.20: 0/1), SP, NS, DS, G1, G2, G3, Gm1, Gm2, Gm3, t1, t2, dt, t3, tx, t4, P1, P2, P3, Px, P4, V1, V2, V3, M1, M2, M3, Q, Qg, Ti, Tn, Tsh, ST1-ST16 and inputs { X4-X14 } (input tests: Hz, mA, Ω), raw in the device's units and named after Логика's documents (НС → NS, ДС → DS: lists of the active numbers; Ти → Ti in hours); what a model does not offer is null. Choosing the supply/return pipe and converting units is left to the flow's collect-device-state. Send any message in to trigger a read (941.10/11: 9 requests, about 40 s through a БАРС-02); the same message comes out with `msg.payload` set to the result (deviceTime/timestamp as epoch ms). On failure nothing goes out and node.error() is called. ADDRESS is the network number NT (0-99, 1 by default); SERIAL_NUMBER, when set, is checked against the serial number (941.10/11: ИД, which is set to it).

Through a GPRS modem that connects to us instead of waiting for a connection (БАРС-02 or ETA GSM; the gateway tells them apart by their hello): set GPRS_MODEM_ID to the identifier the modem sends on connect (БАРС-02: its CBN, e.g. Зарипова_21; ETA GSM: its number, e.g. 0458); HOST and PORT are then unused. GPRS_LINE is the meter's line as the old dispatch system lists it: rs232 | rs232-powered | rs485, baud rate, 8N1 / 8E1 / 8O1 / 8N2 (default rs232-powered 9600 8N1; the meter's own speed is set by its КИ parameter: 0 or 10 = 2400, 1 or 11 = 9600, 2 or 12 = 19200), or none to leave the modem's line as configured (old-firmware БАРС-02 3.0.1). The modems connect to one listener (global gprsModems, flow-space-nodered-a/src/device-readers/gprs-modems.js, port 2910; started at deploy), which reads one meter per modem at a time (several СПТ on one RS-232 line, with different NT, are read one after another); over GPRS the read allows 15 s per request and at least 240 s in all. An ETA GSM keeps its wired RS-232/RS-485 port and gets the speed and format in band. See .docs/bars02/bars02-notes.md and .docs/eta-gsm/eta-gsm-notes.md.
